_readme: FIAT GEAR - the new items, in one go: the deep bases (tiers 7-9 on every slot a runner wears, 10 Oct), the builds pass's uniques, the five sets' pieces, the melee weapons, the small melee and the melee parts (grips and heads), the grenades, the scrap icon and the new ammo grades - every job from long_guns, handguns, helmets, armour, rigs, bags, medical, ammo, parts, uniques, sockets, charms, melee, melee_small, melee_parts, grenades, misc, sets whose art/items/<slug>.png was not on disk when this was generated. 42 jobs.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_items_new_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list). Rides art/reference/items/ref_01..04.png as style like the rest of the pool. A job whose file exists is skipped; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <slug> ++ --force.
Regenerate with python3 tools/make_item_manifests.py on the machine that holds the art, so the 'exists' test sees the real folder; the per-group manifests are the same jobs grouped.
